posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
That episode was an absolute hoot from start to finish. Glad to see some of the regulars made it to the show. :D

Was great to meet Christopher's bro, he's pretty adorable.

I cheerfully dispute Christopher's notion that the meta layer in Sentinels was "unnecessary". Not only does it add a fun conceit that arguably makes Sentinels even more fun than if it was just a straight up fictiona universe, but it kind of shows what the writing process is like, that you can come up with five billion things readers will never see just so the things they do see hang together properly.

Really in a way this was kinda a podcast where we talk about the universe behind the universe of Sentinels Comics.

So, basically, much spoiler stuff as a result. So much.

I love how Sonvar has become a shorthand for asking too many questions, or that Christopher and Adam want to keep the podcast going just so they can find out the end of the Flesh War. XD Or how everybody in the audience seemed to be seriously considering joining the Cult of Gloom.

(I admit that wondering if there will be a Second Annual Letters Page made me want to start doing the math to see how many characters we actually have left to discuss to see if it'll go for another 52 weeks. I guess doing some of the environments might make sense too...)
